name: Can I DIY the bathroom addition framing to save money?

mainEntity.name: Can I DIY the bathroom addition framing to save money?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY framing might seem like a way to save costs, it's generally not recommended for a bathroom addition unless you have significant prior experience in structural carpentry and a thorough understanding of building codes. Incorrect framing can lead to serious structural integrity issues, safety hazards, and costly repairs down the line. Furthermore, improper work can complicate obtaining necessary permits and passing inspections, potentially delaying your project. Hiring a professional contractor ensures the work is done correctly, safely, and to code.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY bathroom addition framing is generally not recommended unless you have extensive structural carpentry experience and code knowledge. Incorrect framing can lead to structural issues and costly problems.
